pages.title: Black Worker of Filth
pages.text: Place a carved pumpkin on a maggot block to summon a fly.$(br2)Flies are the basic resource for breeding chests and fly barrels.

pages.title: Special Variants
pages.text: A fly turns blue from drowning damage, green from cactus damage, brown from a poop ball, and black from a lightning strike.$(br2)Feeding a fly chili turns it red.
